Manual Swiping (if no ‘Close all’ option exists):
Swipe each app card up, down, left, or right off the screen to close apps individually 

Force Stopping Apps via Settings (Optional)
Open Settings  Apps (or Apps & Notifications), select the app you want to stop, and tap Force Stop to halt the app completely, including background processes
